title: ORB movement-to-cost and persistence diagnostics

opportunity.definition: Prior-session Wilder ATR20 / standard round-trip per-share friction
opportunity.atr_seed: Existing shared Wilder ATR: first TR high-low; first-observation EWM seed; minimum 20 sessions; shifted one session
opportunity.friction_definition: 2 entry ticks + 2 stop-exit ticks at $0.01 + 2 * $0.0035 commission/share
opportunity.limitations: A standardizer, not measured execution cost: EOD exit uses one tick; per-order minimum/cap, spread variation, fees, borrow and market impact are not represented. Original net outcomes retain actual modelled commissions/slippage.

persistence.definition: abs(C[t]-C[t-6]) / sum(abs(diff(C))) over six contiguous 5-minute close changes in the current regular session
persistence.availability: Last signal bar closes at entry timestamp. Use bar stamped entry minus 5 minutes, never the entry bar close
persistence.missing_policy: Require seven closes at consecutive 5-minute stamps in one local session; no overnight gaps, forward fill, shortened window or substitution. Dead-flat path is 0, not trending. NaN propagates until outside the window
persistence.early_entries: Unavailable before 10:05 ET; report these separately, never classify them low or discard from the baseline

thresholds.method: Separate per-symbol median for each feature over source trades through 2021-12-31 with both features available; high strictly greater than median, low otherwise
thresholds.freeze: Calibration feature values only; no outcomes used for medians. Same cutoffs for all years and all robustness slices

comparisons: opportunity: high minus low mean net R among jointly measurable source trades
persistence: high minus low mean net R among jointly measurable source trades
interaction: HH - HL - LH + LL mean net R; first letter opportunity, second persistence

analysis.familywise_note: Bonferroni for these three contrasts only, not the programme's prior 101 trials or post-hoc subgroup analysis
analysis.prediction: Both high-minus-low contrasts positive; positive interaction is an additional, stronger prediction, not necessary for additive benefit
analysis.advance_rule: A main-effect candidate deserves a separately registered executable-gate study only if later reused-data contrast >= 0.05R, nominal CI excludes zero, sign is positive outside 2020/2022 and in at least 4/5 symbols, and survives removing the 20 best baseline dates with positive sign. Report three-comparison intervals and every failed criterion; this is triage, never confirmation
analysis.sensitivity: Remove all trades on the 20 best dates ranked by full baseline summed net R; fixed-quantity additional round-trip friction of $0.02 and $0.04/share
analysis.calendar: Report all observed regular symbol-sessions, including no-trade dates; diagnostic group dollar contributions divided by this same all-session denominator are not simulated gated-strategy returns
analysis.portfolio_goal: Positive net returns with less drawdown, limited overnight exposure, and returns that complement buy-and-hold
analysis.portfolio_limit: Only verify baseline daily closed-trade drawdown, zero overnight holds, all-session dollars and daily price-return correlation/downside co-movement. No risk-matched combined portfolio, optimized allocation or claim of improved filtered equity
analysis.stopping_rule: One feature set, one window each, one calibration split, three contrasts; no threshold/window/exit retuning after results. Negative/inconclusive is a completed study. No executable gate is tested in this protocol
